visual_links.label_zh: 董氏奇穴 · 大白穴 (eLotus CORE 英文圖解)
董氏心氣神針 · 大白穴 (中文傳承網圖解)

points.acumethod_zh: 手握拳，第一掌骨與第二掌骨之間，距靈骨穴遠端一寸是穴。直刺0.5～1.0寸；小兒高熱三棱針點刺出黑血。成人常與靈骨穴倒馬。
points.anatomy_zh: 此處有橈動脈、橈神經、肺支神經。
points.anatomy_en: Radial artery, radial nerve, Lung branch nerve.
points.acumethod_en: Needle 0.5-1.0 cun; bleed dark blood for high fever. Pair with Linggu (T 22.05).
contraindications_en: Contraindicated during pregnancy due to strong qi-moving effect.

points.location_en: On the dorsum of the hand, at the junction of 1st & 2nd metacarpal bones, 1 cun proximal to Hegu (LI4). Can penetrate to Zhongxian.
points.location_zh: 握拳取穴，在拇指與食指叉骨間，第一掌骨與第二掌骨結合處（即合谷穴後一寸）。可透重仙穴。
contraindications: 孕婦絕對禁針（發汗行氣力強，易致流產）。

points.anatomy_zh: 淺層分佈手背靜脈、橈神經淺枝。深層分佈正中神經固有掌側指神經、肺支神經、心及腎神經。
points.anatomy_en: Superficial: dorsal venous network, radial nerve branch; Deep: median nerve, Lung branch, Heart & Kidney reaction areas.
points.acumethod_en: Form a fist to locate. Needle perpendicularly 1.5-2.0 cun or penetrate to Zhongxian. Pair with Dabai (T 22.04) for #1 Tung Master Pair.
contraindications_en: Strictly contraindicated in pregnancy (risk of inducing labor).

points.location_en: On the dorsum of the hand, between 4th & 5th metacarpal bones, 0.5 cun proximal to Zhongzhu (TE3).
points.location_zh: 手背第四掌骨與第五掌骨小頭後方凹陷處（即中渚穴後五分）。
